content.title: Microsoft Surface: Laptops, Tablets & Computers | Microsoft
content.text: Choosing a Surface Copilot+ PC for gaming and streaming depends on how you plan to use it—whether you game and stream separately, do both at the same time, or switch between different setups. When comparing streaming and gaming PCs, consider: How you plan to use gaming and streaming: Some players stream gameplay live, while others use streaming services to play games, watch content, or game casually. Understanding your usage helps narrow the right balance of performance and flexibility.Support for accessories and monitors: Both gaming and streaming often involve external monitors, controllers, microphones, webcams, and other accessories. A PC that supports standard peripherals makes it easier to customize or expand your setup.Connectivity and reliability: Stable connections and modern ports are important for both gaming and streaming, especially when using multiple accessories or external displays.Flexibility in gaming options: Many players use a mix of local PC gaming and cloud gaming. Choosing a Windows PC that supports both gives you more ways to play and stream content.Form factor and space: Whether you prefer a portable PC or a more stationary setup can influence what works best for gaming and streaming in your space. For many users, the best PC for gaming and streaming is one that supports Windows gaming, works with common accessories and monitors, and adapts to different ways of playing and watching. Comparing devices side by side can help you find the option that fits your needs now and as they evolve. Surface Copilot+ PCs are designed for productivity and AI-powered experiences, but they can absolutely play games too. Many popular titles run well on Surface, especially with features like Auto Super Resolution that use on-device AI to enhance your gameplay. They're a great fit if you enjoy gaming as part of a well-rounded PC experience — catching up on your favorite games between classes or meetings, playing on the go with outstanding battery life, or streaming games via cloud gaming services like Xbox Cloud Gaming.
